name: Planet Dandelion Clock
description: An enormous dandelion clock where each seed is a tiny glowing planet, floating in a twilight meadow with a small figure reaching up.
prompt: A giant luminous dandelion seed head in a twilight meadow, each seed a tiny glowing planet with rings and continents, a small silhouetted figure reaching toward it, soft purple and orange sky, magical bokeh, ethereal lighting, wonder and curiosity, highly detailed, no text, no watermarks
caption: Make a wish on a universe. 🌠🌱✨ Some dandelions don't scatter seeds—they scatter worlds.
